summary: Reproduces an ISO protocol that lets end systems and intermediate systems exchange configuration and routing information. This helps the Network Layer do its routing and relaying work, and is meant to be used alongside ISO 8473 (CLNP). It is part of the OSI set of standards.

eli5.summary: Computers and the routers near them need to introduce themselves. This protocol is how a computer says "I'm here" and a router says "I can take your mail further."

questions: how do end systems find intermediate systems in osi
